member.name: T:JordiAragonZaragoza.Cinema.Reservation.Worker.Seeder.SeedData
member.summary: Deterministic seed data for the system and functional tests. Every instance builds its own aggregates and read models, so no mutable state is shared between populations. Identifiers are stable and exposed through . Use ONE instance per population: the read models receive their Scope when populated and EF Core tracks them.

member.name: T:JordiAragonZaragoza.Cinema.Reservation.Worker.Seeder.SeedValues
member.summary: Deterministic values of the seed data. They are immutable, so they can be safely shared between processes, tests and HTTP files. Tests and requests should reference these ids instead of reading them from .
